vulnerabilities.name: Meta React Server Components Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Meta React Server Components contains a remote code execution vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution by exploiting a flaw in how React decodes payloads sent to React Server Function endpoints.

vulnerabilities.name: OpenPLC ScadaBR Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: OpenPLC ScadaBR contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows remote authenticated users to upload and execute arbitrary JSP files via view_edit.shtm.

vulnerabilities.name: Android Framework Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for information disclosure.

vulnerabilities.name: Android Framework Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Android Framework contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.
